testcase.name: Scenario: Save a new part while closing its tab: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:134:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Save a new part while closing its tab ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` is open and active ✔ And the user creates a new unsaved metric part, starts a sketch on its XY plane and finishes the sketch ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ And an empty disposable output folder is available ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the new part's document tab ✔ And the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt ✔ And the user navigates to the disposable output folder in Save As ✔ And the user accepts the suggested file name in the Save As dialog ✔ Then the part file exists at the selected location ✔ And the new part's tab disappears ✔ And the previously active part is displayed ✔ When the user reopens the saved part file ✔ Then the reopened part is active ✔ And its sketch is listed in the model browser
